step_by_step_reasoning:
1. Identified core data ingest components: Satellite data (ThirdParty) ingested into S3, and Mobile Device GIS data (UserCompanyAgent) stored in PostgreSQL database (RDS).
2. Identified processing workflow: AWS Lambda triggers parallel execution on AWS SageMaker. SageMaker fetches inputs from Registry of Open Data (S3 bucket), raw imagery S3 bucket, and field boundaries from PostgreSQL. Upon completion, SageMaker writes spatial statistics to PostgreSQL and processed imagery back to S3.
3. Identified presentation workflow: Application UI services running on AWS EKS (backed by EC2 Graviton instances) expose geospatial map layers through Amazon CloudFront CDN, delivering efficient cached content to agriculture sector end users (UserConsumerWeb).
